title: Generating clustered gaze coordinates
description: You can follow supplied regions into a synthetic gaze array.

steps.description: You define screen dimensions and five region visits. Each visit supplies a center coordinate and a dwell value, with the content center appearing twice.
For each visit, the code derives n and generates noisy x and y coordinates around its center. column_stack pairs the coordinates into sample rows.

steps.question: Does the comment about saccades add any transition coordinates?
steps.answer: No. This block appends only the generated clusters and then stacks them directly.

steps.description: You combine all clusters into gaze and build a sample-index-based t array. The supplied output reports 240 gaze samples.
